summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Agrius the Calydonian usurper and of other bearers of the name in Greek myth.

story.text: Apollodorus names Agrius among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Medon and before Promus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
